main_body: sci-fi metal floor / wall panel tiles (4x3 grid)
top_band: blue-grey metal floor panel surface across rows 0-47
evidence: This is a 4x3 grid of 16x16 terrain/floor tiles (metal panels with rivets, recessed vents, seams, and glowing blue lights). As terrain tiles, top-down/flat panel projection is expected and valid.

style.evidence: The metal panels use a 5-step blue-grey ramp with dark slate-blue seams/recesses (no pure black sticker outlines) plus a 4-step cyan ramp for the indicator lights. Rivets, bevels, and panel seams break up the 16x16 tiles nicely so there are no large flat fills, though the overall micro-texture is cleaner and slightly less dense than the cobblestone reference.
